rows.name: switch-exact-200
rows.source: set total 0;for {set i 0} {$i<200} {incr i} {switch [expr {$i%3}] {0 {incr total 1} 1 {incr total 2} default {incr total 3}}};set total

rows.name: switch-glob-200
rows.source: set total 0;for {set i 0} {$i<200} {incr i} {switch -glob -nocase {LOG/ready.txt} {*.csv {error wrong} log/* {incr total} default {error missing}}};set total

rows.name: switch-regexp-capture-50
rows.source: set total 0;for {set i 0} {$i<50} {incr i} {switch -regexp -matchvar m -indexvar ix {ADD tea 42} {^ADD ([a-z]+) ([0-9]+)$} {incr total [lindex $m 2]} default {error missing}};list $total $ix

rows.name: switch-regexp-backref-50
rows.source: set total 0;for {set i 0} {$i<50} {incr i} {switch -regexp -matchvar m {abab} {(ab)\1} {incr total} default {error missing}};list $total $m

rows.name: switch-regexp-nested-50
rows.source: set total 0;for {set i 0} {$i<50} {incr i} {switch -regexp -matchvar m aaabbb {((.)+?)*b?} {incr total} default {error missing}};list $total $m

scope: Five small warm-session switch workloads, native and Node measured separately on one host; exact results verified. Different host adapters; no full application, peak memory or cross-platform acceptance.
